Card Q&A.a: Yes. If either a level 5 Digimon card or a green Tamer card are present in the 3 cards you reveal, you get to add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the 3 cards I reveal with this card's effect don't contain both a level 5 Digimon card and a green Tamer card, do I still get to add a card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: 1 level 5 or lower Digimon card and 1 green Tamer card.
Card Q&A.q: What cards are added to my hand by this card's [When Digivolving] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Reveal 3 cards from the top of your deck. Add 1 level 5 Digimon card and 1 green Tamer card among them to your hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order.
